resources.string: Showing saved data. Rounds you finish will sync when you reconnect.
Saved offline. Your scorecard will upload automatically when you\'re back online.
This round is waiting to sync. Its summary appears once it has uploaded.
Rounds you finish without a connection are saved on this phone and upload on their own once you\'re back online, even if TeeUp is closed.
Tee times, your rounds and your profile are kept on this phone after they load, so you can still view them offline.
Back online. Uploading your saved rounds now.
Partners can see and join your partners-only groups, and get an invite when you create one.
Type at least 2 letters to search.
No partners yet. Find golfers you play with below, or add them from a group you\'ve joined.
That didn\'t work. Check your connection and try again.
Only your playing partners can see and join this group, and each of them gets a push invite.
Precise location is off, so distances are from the tee. Allow precise location in Settings for live GPS.
Weak GPS signal (±%1$d m). Move into the open. Showing distances from the tee.
GPS signal lost %1$d s ago. Distances may be out of date.
You\'re %1$d m from this hole. Showing distances from the tee.
%1$s · you tee off at %2$s. Time to head to the course.
Par %1$d · up to %2$d strokes, putts included.
This course\'s scorecard isn\'t in TeeUp yet. Pick the hole\'s par from the club\'s card:
On a par %1$d you can\'t take more than %2$d strokes (par + 3, putts included). Pick up and enter %2$d.
Putts count as strokes, so you can\'t have more than %1$d putts with %1$d strokes.
Pick this hole\'s par first: it sets the most strokes you can take.
